French Coastal Charm
Jul 2025 • Solo
CABANON PALACE - @cabanon.palace - is a refined ode to French gastronomy, seamlessly blending tradition with a touch of Vietnamese sensibility. The restaurant’s philosophy revolves around authenticity—eschewing fleeting trends in favor of time-honored techniques and premium ingredients. Every element, from the meticulously crafted sauces to the artful plating, speaks of a kitchen deeply rooted in French culinary heritage while embracing the freshness of local produce. 

The ambience strikes a perfect balance between elegance and warmth. The space is intimate yet airy, with soft lighting and tasteful décor that evokes a Parisian brasserie without feeling overly formal. Whether seated indoors amidst crisp linens and polished silverware or outside with a gentle coastal breeze, the setting enhances the dining experience without overshadowing the food. 

Service is polished and intuitive—attentive without being intrusive. The staff demonstrates a genuine passion for the cuisine, offering thoughtful recommendations and ensuring each course flows seamlessly. Their knowledge of classic French dining etiquette adds to the restaurant’s sophistication, making it clear that hospitality is as much a priority as the food itself. 

Cabanon Palace excels in delivering a culinary journey that feels both luxurious and heartfelt. It’s a place where the soul of French coastal cuisine is honored, making it a standout destination for discerning diners in Da Nang.

Quirky, lovely, family run
May 2025 • Friends
We loved that this is a family run place with the family there serving customers. They were all so friendly and genuine. 

Pricing is very good for what you get. We would have liked a few more cocktail options but they’ve kept them simple. The wine options are all French and from the area around Marseille where the family is from. The range is good and what we had was very nice. 

We tried the crab bisque - a specialty - which was delicious. Some of our party went for a sharing steak, which could have been between 3 as it was too much for 2. In fairness, they had said it’d feed 2-3. It was well cooked and tasty, as were the side salad and chipped potatoes it came with. I also had a steak (I should have just gone in with the sharing dish with hindsight) which was tender and perfectly cooked. The let down was the lamb shank. My wife said it was a little chewy and didn’t taste of much beyond the honey mentioned on the menu. She also ordered it with chips but it was delivered with mashed potatoes. Given we all had our food she didn’t complain but there was more than enough for her to eat on other plates. 

We didn’t have dessert as we were too full and content with what we had eaten. 

Do have to give special mention to the above and beyond service. One of us wanted a Diet Coke - for allergy reasons - but there was only zero or normal available. They said they found one (then another later) but we suspected they’d been out to the shops to get one. When we asked they said they had. It was such a lovely touch. They did similarly with one of the side salads, making a separate one without the allergy inducing foods in it. 

Apart from the lamb shank, we all really liked our food; the quality and taste was excellent. Service so personal and the place felt like a nice, honest, high end family run place. It’s not a big hotel restaurant but that’s why we liked it. Make sure you go

Excellent 60s inspired French
Apr 2025 • Couples
If you want an authentic experience as if you were dining in the south of France this is a definite must. As a Sydney local who is spoilt for choice here with offerings such as Huberts, I was impressed not just with the food but also the magnificent service. Corsican French cuisine is often overlooked yet they have created several dishes worthy of respect and obviously are passionate about their food and craft. I reccomend the crab bisque and the lamb confit. The wine list shows they have gone to effort sourcing a good variety of French wines. ( no easy feat in Vietnam) My only recommendation would be to add a few Corsican themed or inspired cocktails to the menu! We will happily return here, and promote this venue to other visitors. Thank you.
